brief_summary:
The goal of this clinical trial is to learn if the drug Luseogliflozin works to treat people with diabetes who are taking moderate dose insulin treatment. It will also learn about the safety of the drug Luseogliflozin. The main questions it aims to answer are:

Does Luseogliflozin improve the sugar control of people with diabetes by lowering the insulin resistance numbers in each participants?

What is the likelihood of participants developing of a known side effect of this type of medications which is ketoacidosis when taking Luseogliflozin?

Researchers will compare Luseogliflozin use in one group to a similar group not taking similar medications to see if Luseogliflozin showed any difference in the above.

Participants will:

Either take Luseogliflzoin 2.5mg daily for 12 weeks or no change in medications.

Keep a diary of blood glucose readings during the period of 12 weeks. Blood taking and measurements of blood pressure, weight and waist circumference will be performed at initial visit and again at 12 weeks.
brief_title: A Study in Type 2 Diabetes Patients Who Are Taking Moderate Dose Insulin, Looking at the Effects of the Medication Luseogliflozin on Risk of Ketoacidosis and Insulin Resistance.

eligibility.criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Diagnosis of T2DM
2. BMI \> 23kg/m2
3. Receiving insulin therapy of \> 0.5U/kg/day (basal and/or prandial insulins), on stable dose for the last 12 weeks
4. HbA1c between 6.5 - 10.5%
5. Egfr \>50ml/min

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Type 1 diabetes mellitus
2. Frequent hypoglycemia
3. Recent hospital admission within the past 3 months
4. Persistent elevations of serum transaminase
5. Active systemic inflammatory disease on immunosuppressant therapy
6. Chronic heart failure (New York Heart Association functional class III-IV)
7. Chronic renal failure (egfr \<50) and those requiring dialysis
8. Active hepatic and collagen diseases, malignancy
9. Pregnant, breastfeeding or planning to conceive within the next year -

official_title: Effect of Luseogliflozin on Risk of Ketoacidosis and Insulin Resistance in Type 2 Diabetes Mellitus Patients on Moderate Dose Insulin

primary_outcomes.measure: Change in triglyceride glucose index (TGI) levels
